citations.passage: Assumption on record: throughput scales linearly with scan volume.

Silas benchmarked the OCR pipeline against the ocr-comparison assumption: on
real archival page scans — foxed paper, old typefaces — throughput ran at
roughly forty percent of the assumed rate once image preprocessing landed.

archival scans run at roughly forty percent of
the assumed rate, so the digitization schedule stretches

judge.rationale: The agent correctly captures the four-times-local throughput assumption, linear-scaling premise, and the roughly 40% archival-scan finding from s-006. However, it omits the reference’s key schedule consequence that the digitization schedule was stretched at the Bellweather review (m-007), substituting a different explanation about batching and preprocessing setting the pace.
